events.description: Monica Geller says Joey Tribbiani should go faster with trying the keys in the apartment door's keyhole.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani has one keyhole to try and a huge number of keys.
Joey Tribbiani says Monica Geller should calculate how long trying all the keys will take.
Monica Geller says Chandler Bing and Joey Tribbiani have an excessive number of keys on their keyring.
Rachel Green says Chandler Bing should listen to Rachel Green.
Rachel Green says that because of Chandler Bing's balloon incident, Rachel Green is not currently on a plane watching a flight attendant perform a safety demonstration.
Monica Geller says Rachel Green previously said Rachel Green had the apartment keys.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green did not say she had the apartment keys.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green did not have the apartment keys.
Phoebe Buffay says the discussion about the apartment keys is over.
Phoebe Buffay says no one should say the word 'keys' anymore.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller does not have the apartment keys.
Rachel Green says Monica Geller said Monica Geller had the apartment keys.
Monica Geller says everything is Monica Geller's responsibility and that even making Thanksgiving dinner for everyone is not considered enough.

Monica Geller says Monica Geller is making Thanksgiving dinner for everyone, including making different kinds of potatoes because everyone wants something different, ensuring Phoebe Buffay gets peas and onions and Mario gets tater tots.
Monica Geller says nobody cares what kind of potatoes Monica Geller wants.
Monica Geller says this is Monica Geller's first Thanksgiving hosting.
Monica Geller says the Thanksgiving dinner is all burned.
Chandler Bing says only dogs can hear Monica Geller now.
Chandler Bing says Monica Geller should look at the apartment door.
Chandler Bing says the apartment door is open.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing and Monica Geller are going into the apartment now.
Monica Geller says the turkey is burnt.
Monica Geller says the potatoes are ruined.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing are walking into the apartment.
Ross Geller says the Thanksgiving food does not smell like Ross Geller and Monica Geller's mother's cooking.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller wanted lumps in the mashed potatoes.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller now gets a lump in his serving.
Rachel Green says the plane Rachel Green intended to take has already departed.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is stuck spending Thanksgiving with Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing.
Joey Tribbiani says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing all had better plans.
Joey Tribbiani says spending Thanksgiving together like this was nobody's first choice.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller was working hard to make this Thanksgiving dinner.
Joey Tribbiani says Monica Geller is calling this Thanksgiving dinner delicious.
Monica Geller says everyone should stop arguing right now.
Chandler Bing says the group's bickering makes it feel like Thanksgiving now.
Phoebe Buffay says Ugly Naked Guy is taking his turkey out of the oven.
Phoebe Buffay says Ugly Naked Guy is not alone.
Phoebe Buffay says Ugly Naked Guy is having Thanksgiving dinner with Ugly Naked Gal.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani has to watch Ugly Naked Guy and Ugly Naked Gal having Thanksgiving dinner.
Phoebe Buffay says it is nice that Ugly Naked Guy has someone to share Thanksgiving with.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing will carve the food.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is asking who wants the light cheese.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is asking who wants the dark cheese.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller does not want to know anything about the dark cheese.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is asking if anybody wants to split this serving with Monica Geller.
Phoebe Buffay says Monica Geller and Joey Tribbiani have to make a wish on the wishbone.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is supposed to make a wish now.
Phoebe Buffay says Joey Tribbiani got the bigger half of the wishbone.
Phoebe Buffay says Joey Tribbiani made a wish and asks what Joey Tribbiani wished for.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing would like to propose a toast.
Chandler Bing says this is not the kind of Thanksgiving that Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Monica Geller had planned.
Chandler Bing says this unexpected Thanksgiving has been really great for Chandler Bing because it did not involve divorce or projectile vomiting.

Chandler Bing says that if Rachel Green had gone to Vail, if Monica Geller and Ross Geller had been with their family, and if Joey Tribbiani did not have syphilis, then the group would not be all together now.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is very thankful that Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Monica Geller each had a Thanksgiving that went badly.
Everyone says Chandler Bing's toast is very sweet.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller proposes a toast to a lousy Christmas.
